apps.about:
Keep an eye on your Claude Code usage without breaking flow. Claude Monitor turns your 5-hour and 7-day limits, plus your active sessions, into a clean gauge on your Zeph, so one glance tells you where you stand.

**Two faces, your pick**

- **Circular:** ring gauges, elegant and compact.
- **Linear:** bar gauges, easy to read across the room.

Both mark each active session with a dot.

**Always honest**

- **Live:** your real 5H and 7D percentages, each window's reset time, and when it last updated.
- **Holding:** if the companion link drops, it keeps your last reading and dims it with a freshness note, never a stale number pretending to be fresh.
- **Not synced:** a clear cue before the first sync, never a blank card or a fake zero.

Nothing to set up. Install it and it just works.
apps.description: See how much of your Claude Code 5-hour and 7-day limits you've used, and how many sessions are running, at a glance on your Zeph. Clean ring or bar gauges, synced live from the companion, and always honest about how fresh the reading is.

apps.about:
## What's inside

The **Zeph Tour** is the official welcome app — a _hosted_ demo that renders its face on your Zeph while the companion drives it. It is the fastest way to see what a Zeph app can do, end to end.

### Five screens to explore

- **Welcome** — the home menu, your jumping-off point
- **Components** — every UI primitive on one scrolling surface
- **Playground** — four live `device ↔ companion` round-trips
- **Settings** — a greeting, accent, and clock glance driven by this app's own config
- **About** — a multi-screen scrolling text page

### Try the round-trips

From the Playground, fire a **Ping** and watch it return from the companion, or post a **Notify** that surfaces on the device. Edit a value on the _Settings_ screen and watch it sync live.

Built with the open [Zeph app SDK](https://github.com/zephclick/zeph).

Open it on a connected device to walk through the Welcome home, a Components showcase that renders the whole primitive palette on one scrolling surface, a Playground of four device↔companion round-trips, and a Settings screen driven by this app's own configuration.
